    {"ep": 1, "summary": "Juliana is humiliated at her wedding when her fiancé Gerald marries her sister Clarissa instead, and her family disowns her.", "peak": "Gerald declares he chooses Clarissa over Juliana at the altar", "ends_on": "Juliana stands alone as the congregation watches", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 2, "summary": "Juliana confronts Gerald and her family, declaring her dignity intact despite their betrayal, and leaves the chapel with her head high.", "peak": "Juliana tells Gerald his word is worthless", "ends_on": "Juliana walks out of the chapel alone", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 3, "summary": "A bearded stranger intervenes when guards drag Juliana away, kneels and proposes marriage, offering her his protection and name.", "peak": "The Bearded Stranger proposes to Juliana on one knee", "ends_on": "Juliana gazes at the stranger as the congregation gasps", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 4, "summary": "Juliana accepts the stranger's proposal, they marry in the chapel, and her father disowns her, throwing her mother's ledger into the mud.", "peak": "Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man are pronounced husband and wife", "ends_on": "Juliana and her husband leave the chapel hand in hand", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 5, "summary": "Juliana and her new husband retrieve the ledger, and he comforts her as they leave her former life behind.", "peak": "Alexander kneels to retrieve the muddy ledger for Juliana", "ends_on": "They walk away from the church into the rain", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 6, "summary": "They arrive at his humble cottage in the woods, where Juliana finds peace in the quiet and begins to make it a home.", "peak": "Juliana sweeps the floor while Alexander lights a fire", "ends_on": "Juliana says she doesn't feel afraid sitting with him", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 7, "summary": "Gerald and Clarissa visit to mock them, but the husband's silent menace drives them away.", "peak": "Alexander appears with firewood and Gerald flees", "ends_on": "Juliana and Alexander share a quiet moment after the confrontation", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 8, "summary": "Juliana learns her husband's name is Alexander and discovers his knowledge of healing herbs, deepening their bond.", "peak": "Alexander reveals he knows herbal medicine from soldiering", "ends_on": "Juliana realizes she may have found something more valuable than wealth", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 9, "summary": "Juliana saves a peasant child with herbs, while Gerald reports rumors that Alexander resembles the lost Duke.", "peak": "The child's fever breaks under Juliana's care", "ends_on": "Blond Nobleman whispers 'Impossible' upon hearing of Alexander's scar", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 10, "summary": "Alexander is wounded, and Juliana tends him, their intimacy growing as she sees his scars.", "peak": "Juliana stitches Alexander's wound and they share a charged moment", "ends_on": "Alexander says her touch is the only medicine that eases his pain", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 11, "summary": "Gerald accuses Alexander of theft, leading to a constable's search that seemingly finds a watch in Alexander's coat.", "peak": "The constable finds Gerald's watch in Alexander's coat pocket", "ends_on": "Gerald gloats as Juliana looks on in horror", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 12, "summary": "Juliana defends Alexander, and Clarissa forces her to retrieve a ring from thorny briars to save him from hanging.", "peak": "Clarissa demands Juliana crawl through frozen blackthorn for her ring", "ends_on": "Juliana turns to the briars with fierce resolution", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 13, "summary": "Juliana's hands are shredded retrieving the ring, and Alexander breaks free to save her.", "peak": "Alexander roars and lunges past the constable as Juliana screams", "ends_on": "Juliana finds the ring in the frozen dirt", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 14, "summary": "Alexander tends Juliana's wounds, vowing vengeance on those who hurt her.", "peak": "Alexander bandages Juliana's torn hands and clenches his fist in vengeance", "ends_on": "Alexander swears no one will ever hurt her for protecting him again", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 15, "summary": "Thugs destroy Juliana's herb garden, and Alexander arrives to defend her.", "peak": "Alexander storms out of the cottage and places himself between Juliana and the thugs", "ends_on": "Alexander stares down the three thugs with lethal intent", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 16, "summary": "Alexander defeats the thugs, learning Gerald hired them, and comforts Juliana.", "peak": "Alexander catches a club mid-swing and throws the thug leader against the wall", "ends_on": "Alexander and Juliana gaze at each other as the thugs flee", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 17, "summary": "Juliana and Alexander share tender moments, strengthening their love and trust.", "peak": "Alexander vows no one will hurt Juliana again as long as he draws breath", "ends_on": "Juliana rests her head on Alexander's chest, saying she trusts him more each day", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 18, "summary": "Their cottage burns; Alexander rescues Juliana and the ledger, but they lose their home.", "peak": "Alexander tackles Juliana away from a falling beam and leaps through a window with her", "ends_on": "Alexander vows they took their home but he won't let them take anything else", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 19, "summary": "Villagers shelter them; Alexander learns his mother is imprisoned and his cousin Rupert has usurped the dukedom.", "peak": "Alexander's informant reveals Rupert and Catherine have imprisoned the Dowager Duchess", "ends_on": "Alexander declares the dead Duke is coming home in two days", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 20, "summary": "Rupert and Catherine plot to marry and execute Juliana; Juliana tends villagers despite her own losses.", "peak": "Rupert and Catherine toast their upcoming wedding and Juliana's execution", "ends_on": "Juliana refuses to yield to the cold draft, saying she is not finished", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 21, "summary": "Juliana saves a villager's son, learning the Dowager Duchess is being poisoned.", "peak": "Prudence reveals the Duchess is dying of a mysterious wasting illness", "ends_on": "Juliana realizes the Duchess is being poisoned with arsenic", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 22, "summary": "Juliana infiltrates Ashburton Manor as a maid to treat the Duchess.", "peak": "Juliana enters the Duchess's chamber and recognizes arsenic symptoms", "ends_on": "Juliana whispers 'Someone is poisoning her' as footsteps approach", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 23, "summary": "Juliana identifies arsenic poisoning and treats the Duchess, but they are discovered.", "peak": "Juliana administers charcoal antidote as the door opens", "ends_on": "A noblewoman enters and catches Juliana with the remedy", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 24, "summary": "Catherine whips Juliana and forces her to scrub hearths, but Juliana vows to return.", "peak": "Catherine strikes Juliana with a riding crop", "ends_on": "Juliana hides her ledger and vows 'I will return. You cannot stop the healer.'", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 25, "summary": "Juliana tells Alexander about the poisoning; he is furious but supports her return.", "peak": "Alexander clenches his fist in rage upon hearing of the poisoning", "ends_on": "Alexander walks beside Juliana, demanding she tell him everything", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 26, "summary": "Juliana continues treating the Duchess, who recognizes Alexander's ring on Juliana's hand.", "peak": "The Duchess gasps at the Ashbourne crest on Juliana's ring", "ends_on": "The Duchess demands to know where Juliana got the ring", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 27, "summary": "The Duchess realizes Alexander is alive; Catherine and Rupert arrest Juliana for witchcraft.", "peak": "Catherine exposes Juliana as Lady Juliana Ashcroft and seizes her ledger", "ends_on": "Juliana is dragged away as Catherine gloats over her mother's book", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 28, "summary": "Catherine exposes Juliana's noble identity and steals her mother's ledger and locket.", "peak": "The Duchess accuses Catherine and Rupert of poisoning her before collapsing", "ends_on": "Catherine orders Juliana to the wet cells and claims the ledger as evidence", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 29, "summary": "Juliana is thrown in a dungeon, defiant that Alexander will come for her.", "peak": "Juliana screams she saved the Duchess as the iron door slams", "ends_on": "Juliana grips the bars, whispering Alexander's name as wedding bells toll", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 30, "summary": "Rupert and Sterling plan a show trial for witchcraft to execute Juliana before the wedding.", "peak": "Sterling orders Rupert to manufacture evidence and frame the trial", "ends_on": "Juliana clutches a rag in her cell as the episode cuts to black", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 31, "summary": "Catherine burns Juliana's ledger, but Juliana refuses to break, declaring her love for Alexander.", "peak": "Catherine holds a branding iron to Juliana's face as the ledger burns", "ends_on": "Juliana tells Catherine cruelty doesn't make her powerful", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 32, "summary": "Juliana's defiance shames Catherine; a maid is coerced into false testimony of witchcraft.", "peak": "Juliana declares she was freed by Gerald's rejection and found a man of honor", "ends_on": "Catherine raises the branding iron to Juliana's eye", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 33, "summary": "Lord Sterling forces a maid to lie that Juliana performed witchcraft rituals.", "peak": "Sterling threatens the maid's brother to secure false testimony", "ends_on": "The maid weeps, apologizing to Juliana as Sterling dismisses her", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 34, "summary": "Juliana stands trial, refuses to renounce healing, and is sentenced to death.", "peak": "The Judge raises his hand in judgment over Juliana", "ends_on": "Juliana stands unbroken before the court as the gavel falls", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 35, "summary": "Alexander's mother escapes the manor and reunites with him, revealing Rupert and Sterling's betrayal.", "peak": "Alexander's mother recognizes him and reveals she was told he died", "ends_on": "Alexander vows the dead Duke is coming home before the wedding", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 36, "summary": "Alexander learns the full truth of the ambush and vows to reclaim his title before Juliana's execution.", "peak": "Alexander's mother confirms Juliana is to be executed after Rupert's wedding", "ends_on": "Alexander stares into the snowy woods, declaring he has two days", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 37, "summary": "Rupert and Catherine prepare their wedding and Juliana's execution; Juliana remains defiant in her cell.", "peak": "Clarissa gloats that Juliana's execution will be a lesson to all women", "ends_on": "Juliana curls her fingers in defiance, saying they cannot take who she is", "ends_unresolved": true},
    {"ep": 38, "summary": "A kind guard feeds Juliana; she hears wedding bells and prepares to die.", "peak": "Juliana hears the cathedral bells and realizes the wedding has begun", "ends_on": "Juliana grips the bars, smiling defiantly and whispering Alexander's name", "ends_unresolved": true},
